system.description:
Starting at 6th level, your Genjutsu is woven into your movements making people question if you were ever there to begin with. When you would take damage as a result of an attack and your Duplicity is active, you can spend your Reaction and 1 Actualization Die to swap places with it. The attack automatically hits your Duplicity instead of you.

| Betray Yourself – Identity Crisis / This special condition is treated as a Mental Condition. / A creature suffering from an Identity Crisis finds themselves to be their own enemy. Each turn they spend all of their actions attacking themselves with damaging jutsu, effects and abilities, treating each attack as a critical hit. / If one of their allies spends their Reaction talking to the creature with an Identity Crisis they can remake their saving throw at advantage. |
